items.scope: All Netskope products and services.
Unisoc issues only.
EA issues only.

All BeyondTrust products, including PasswordSafe, Privileged Remote Access, Remote Support, Privilege Management for Windows/Mac, Privilege Management for Unix/Linux, Identity Security Insights, Active Directory (AD) Bridge, and Total PASM.
Siemens issues only.
ASUSTOR issues only.

System vulnerabilities regarding the Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch Lite, and vulnerabilities regarding Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch applications for which Nintendo is the publisher worldwide.

CVEs requested by code owners using the GitHub Security Advisories feature and vulnerabilities affecting open source projects discovered by security researchers at GitHub or Microsoft not covered by another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities in Snyk products and vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, Snyk that are not in another CNA’s scope.
NEC issues only.
Caliptra Project components and vulnerabilities that are not in another CNA’s scope.
SICK AG issues and issues in EHS products (when related to the Endress+Hauser SICK (EHS) joint venture).
Vulnerabilities in Commvault SaaS and software products only.
Vulnerabilities in Forescout products and vulnerabilities in other products discovered by Forescout that are not in another CNA's scope.
Vulnerability assignment related to its vulnerability coordination role.

Vulnerabilities in Protect AI products, third-party code vulnerabilities reported by researchers collaborating with huntr and vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, Protect AI that are not in another CNA’s scope.
MongoDB products only, not including end-of-life components or products.
Vulnerabilities in the following Altium products only: Altium Designer, A365, Octopart, and Altium Enterprise Server.
All BlackBerry products identified on https://www.blackberry.com/us/en.
Vulnerabilities in third-party products discovered by ZUSO ART that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Supported Milestone XProtect products.
Eaton issues only.
Open source projects hosted on https://github.com/openam-jp.
Vulnerabilities discovered in the services and applications of the MeetMe and DuoxMe products that are not covered by another CNA’s scope.
Bosch products only.
Xpdf open source project, including the xpdf viewer and associated command line tools.
Everpure (formerly Pure Storage, Inc.) products only.
All products and services developed and/or sold by Panasonic Group companies.
Projects listed on its Alibaba GitHub website only.

WordPress Plugins, Themes, and Core Vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, the Wordfence/Defiant team. Also, vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by the Wordfence/Defiant team that are not in another CNA’s scope.
ABB issues only.
Jaspersoft products and services only.
Intel branded products and technologies and Intel managed open source projects.
All ESET products only and vulnerabilities discovered by ESET that are not covered by another CNA’s scope.
All Gallagher security products only.
All IQSIGHT (formerly Bosch Building Technology - Video Systems) products including end-of-life products.
Zoom and Keybase issues only.
Vulnerabilities in software discovered by NCSC-FI, and vulnerabilities reported to NCSC-FI for coordinated disclosure, which are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities in supported Ivanti products and infrastructure, excluding third-party components, and meeting severity thresholds defined in Ivanti’s Disclosure Policy found here.

Vulnerabilities in Delinea products or services listed on delinea.com, or vulnerabilities in third-party products or services discovered by or reported to Delinea, unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
All vulnerabilities on software products that our company provides, including KNIME Analytics Platform, KNIME Server, and KNIME Hub.
Vulnerabilities discovered by SRA that are not within the scope of another CNA.
SolarWinds products only.
All products of RT-Labs AB, excluding end-of-life-products; as well as vulnerabilities in third-party products used by RT-Labs AB that are not in the scope of another CNA.
Trend Micro supported products, including any end-of-life products.
Supermicro branded products, managed system, or software projects.
All upKeeper Solutions products, excluding end-of-life (EOL) as listed in the upKeeper Solutions End of Life Policy.
Synology issues only.
Pandora FMS, Pandora ITSM, and Pandora RC issues only.
All currently supported PTC software products and cloud/SaaS services.
